why_not_one_block_off: 25 covers 9th-12th, 32 covers 12th-15th; both print 12TH ST. beside the line (32's label at its top margin next to the adjoining numeral 25). 25's SE23 south face carries 1414-1424 (12th St even run), 32's NW48 north face carries 1501-1511 (odd 1500 run east of Ave N) and the avenue frontage restarts at 1201 (12th-13th). 25 faces 3547/3788 (241 px); on 32 only the south face (337) is drawn, the north face coincides with the neatline (~92-94), so the centre is 337-121 = 216 (cross-check: 13th St centre 1363.5 minus the 1153 px pitch = 210). The shared band is only the Ave N corridor, so this is a corner tie.
